name: Espadrilles
about: Handmade traditional canvas shoes with rope soles. They have been made in Barcelona for generations, so they are a classic local buy.
tip: Try them on before you buy to check the fit.

name: Caganer figurine
about: A small figure of a man squatting, a Catalan Christmas tradition. It is placed in nativity scenes and reflects local folk humor.
tip: Check the recipient's taste first, since the figure can be seen as cheeky.

name: Turrón
about: A traditional nougat made with almonds and honey. It is a Catalan Christmas sweet, and Vicens is a well-known local maker.
tip: Buy a small box first if you are unsure which flavor the recipient likes.
